# Audit events

Every audited action is one event. It is stored in the database (**Admin → Audit Logs**, CSV export) and, with `LOG_INCLUDE_AUDIT=true` (the default), written to stdout as one line, so the same fields can be filtered in the UI and in your log platform. The **ECS** names apply with `LOG_FORMAT=ecs`; `json` uses the plain names.

Reads are audited too (`deployment.list`, `pod.get`, `pod.logs`), refused ones included. The lists the UI reloads on its own are not (they send `X-OpenConsole-Refresh: auto`); the HTTP request log still has every request. With an API key that header is ignored: every read is audited.

## Fields

| Field | ECS | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `event` | `event.action` | The action, `<resource type>.<verb>`: `deployment.restart`, `secret.reveal`, `user.login`. |
| `verb` | `openconsole.verb` | What was done (see Verbs below). |
| `outcome` | `openconsole.outcome` | How it ended (see Outcomes below). In ECS also `event.outcome`: `success` or `failure`. |
| `reason` | `event.reason` | Why it was denied or failed: `forbidden`, `feature_disabled`, `admin_only`, `api_access_policy`, `k8s_forbidden`, `not_found`, `bad_password`, … |
| `user` | `user.name` | Who: the signed-in user (for a failed sign-in, the name typed). |
| `auth_source` | `openconsole.auth_source` | Where the account signs in: `local`, `ldap` or `azure`. |
| `cluster` | `openconsole.cluster` | The cluster the action targeted. Empty for actions that don't run on a cluster (sign-ins, users, roles, settings, saved views). A permission grant records the grant's cluster (empty = all clusters). |
| `cluster_id` | `openconsole.cluster_id` | The id of that cluster. |
| `namespace` | `openconsole.namespace` | The target's namespace. |
| `resource_type` | `openconsole.resource_type` | Singular resource type: `deployment`, `pod`, `user`, `api_key`, … |
| `resource_name` | `openconsole.resource_name` | The target's name; `*` for a list. |
| `request_id` | `http.request.id` | Same as the `http.request` log line of the request, and the `X-Request-Id` response header. |
| `remote_ip` | `source.ip` | Client address: the first `X-Forwarded-For` entry, else `X-Real-Ip`, else the connection's address. |
| `user_agent` | `user_agent.original` | The client's User-Agent. |
| `api_key_id` | `openconsole.api_key.id` | The API key the action was taken with; empty for a web session. |
| `api_key_name` | `openconsole.api_key.name` | That key's name. |

## Actions

The action is `<resource type>.<verb>`. Read from the handlers' code; an action shows every outcome it can end with. `<resource>` stands for any Kubernetes resource type the check is made for (`pod`, `deployment`, …).

## Verbs

| Verb | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `list` | listed (`*` as the name) |
| `get` | read one object |
| `logs` | read or followed logs |
| `exec` | opened a shell (`phase` start / end) or ran one command (`mode` command) |
| `restart` | rolling restart |
| `scale` | changed the replica count |
| `apply` | applied YAML (`dry_run` true for the dry run) |
| `view_yaml` | opened the YAML (for a Secret: the editor, which shows the values) |
| `reveal` | revealed one Secret value |
| `view` | played a session recording |
| `download` | downloaded a session recording |
| `create` | created |
| `update` | changed |
| `delete` | deleted |
| `share` | shared or unshared a saved view |
| `select` | picked a cluster to work on |
| `activate` | made a cluster the default |
| `deactivate` | deactivated |
| `revoke` | revoked a session or an API key |
| `export` | exported a CSV |
| `import` | imported users from LDAP |
| `login` | signed in |
| `change_password` | changed one's own password |
| `reset_password` | an admin set a new password for a local user |
| `evict` | deleted a recording to stay within the disk quota |
| `purge` | deleted recordings past their retention |
| `view_overview` | opened the admin overview |
| `regenerate` | replaced an API key's secret |
| `use` | presented an API key (recorded only when it was refused or rate limited) |

## Outcomes

| Outcome | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `success` | done |
| `denied` | refused by OpenConsole: permission, feature flag, API key policy, admin only |
| `failed` | allowed, but it didn't work: Kubernetes refused it, not found, conflict, bad password |
| `rate_limited` | too many at once: open shells per user, API key requests per second |
| `locked` | sign-in refused while the account is locked after failed attempts |

## Details

A fixed set of typed keys; each is its own field on the log line. They never hold a secret value, a YAML body, a password or a token. **Type** is the Elasticsearch type in `deploy/elk`.

| Key | Type | ECS | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account_source` | keyword | `openconsole.account_source` | `user.*`: the target account's source |
| `admin_scope` | boolean | `openconsole.admin_scope` | `api_key.*`: the key holds the Admin API scope |
| `all` | boolean | `openconsole.all` | `session.revoke`, `api_key.revoke`: every one of the user's |
| `api_access` | keyword | `openconsole.api_access` | `role.update`, `user.update`: API access mode (`off`, `safe_read`, `full`, `roles`) |
| `auto_provisioned` | boolean | `openconsole.auto_provisioned` | `user.create`: created on first LDAP sign-in |
| `by_admin` | boolean | `openconsole.by_admin` | `api_key.revoke`: an admin revoked another user's key |
| `bytes_in` | long | `openconsole.bytes_in` | `pod.exec` shell end: bytes typed |
| `bytes_out` | long | `openconsole.bytes_out` | `pod.exec`: bytes of output |
| `changed` | keyword | `openconsole.changed` | `*.update`: names of the fields changed, never their values |
| `command` | keyword | `openconsole.command` | `pod.exec` shell: the shell started (`/bin/sh`, …) |
| `comment` | text | `openconsole.comment` | `api_key.revoke`: the admin's reason |
| `container` | keyword | `openconsole.container` | `pod.exec`, `pod.logs`, `recording.create`: the container |
| `count` | long | `openconsole.count` | `*.export`, `*.list` of API keys, `user.import`, `recording.purge`, `api_key.revoke` all: how many |
| `dry_run` | boolean | `openconsole.dry_run` | `*.apply`: true for the server-side dry run |
| `duration_ms` | long | `openconsole.duration_ms` | `pod.exec`, `recording.create`: how long it ran |
| `error` | text | `error.message` | `failed` events: the error message (in ECS `error.message`) |
| `exit_code` | long | `openconsole.exit_code` | `pod.exec`: the exit code |
| `expires_at` | date | `openconsole.expires_at` | `api_key.*`: expiry |
| `grant` | keyword | `openconsole.grant` | `permission.*`: `resource:action` |
| `groups` | long | `openconsole.groups` | `user.*`, `user.import`: number of groups |
| `id` | long | `openconsole.id` | `api_key.*`, `permission.*`, `recording.delete`: the id |
| `is_active` | boolean | `openconsole.is_active` | `user.update`: active after the change |
| `is_admin` | boolean | `openconsole.is_admin` | `user.*`: admin after the change |
| `key` | keyword | `openconsole.key` | `secret.reveal`: the key name (never the value) |
| `linked_by` | keyword | `openconsole.linked_by` | `user.login` with Azure AD: the claim a pre-created account was matched by (UPN or e-mail) |
| `login_method` | keyword | `openconsole.login_method` | `user.login`: `local`, `ldap` or `azure` |
| `max_sessions` | long | `openconsole.max_sessions` | `pod.exec` rate limited: the per-user limit |
| `mode` | keyword | `openconsole.mode` | `pod.exec`: `command` for one command over the API |
| `must_change` | boolean | `openconsole.must_change` | `user.reset_password`: the user must choose a new password |
| `owner` | keyword | `openconsole.owner` | `recording.evict`, `saved_view.*`, `api_key.revoke` by an admin: whose it is |
| `phase` | keyword | `openconsole.phase` | `pod.exec` shell: `start` or `end` |
| `pod` | keyword | `openconsole.pod` | `recording.create`, `recording.evict`: the pod of the shell |
| `pods` | long | `openconsole.pods` | `deployment.logs`, `job.logs`: how many pods the stream follows |
| `previous` | boolean | `openconsole.previous` | `pod.logs`: logs of the previous (crashed) container |
| `program` | keyword | `openconsole.program` | `pod.exec` command: the program only (first element), never the arguments |
| `recording_id` | keyword | `openconsole.recording_id` | `pod.exec` command: the session recording's id |
| `replicas_from` | long | `openconsole.replicas_from` | `*.scale`: replicas before |
| `replicas_to` | long | `openconsole.replicas_to` | `*.scale`: replicas requested |
| `restarted_at` | date | `openconsole.restarted_at` | `deployment.restart`: the time written to the pod template |
| `retention_days` | long | `openconsole.retention_days` | `recording.purge`: the retention applied |
| `role` | keyword | `openconsole.role` | `permission.*`: the role |
| `session_id` | keyword | `openconsole.session_id` | `session.revoke`: the sign-in session revoked |
| `shared` | boolean | `openconsole.shared` | `saved_view.*`: shared with everyone |
| `signed_in_as` | keyword | `openconsole.signed_in_as` | `user.login` with Azure AD: the name the user signed in with |
| `size_bytes` | long | `openconsole.size_bytes` | `recording.*`: file size (`recording.purge`: bytes freed) |
| `started_at` | date | `openconsole.started_at` | `recording.evict`: when the recorded session started |
| `summary` | text | `openconsole.summary` | `settings.update`, `api_key.*`, `user.import`: a short summary of what was set |
| `truncate_reason` | keyword | `openconsole.truncate_reason` | `pod.exec` end: why the recording stopped early (size cap, disk quota) |
| `yaml_from` | keyword | `openconsole.yaml_from` | `*.apply`: sha256 prefix of the object before (never the YAML) |
| `yaml_to` | keyword | `openconsole.yaml_to` | `*.apply`: sha256 prefix of the YAML applied |
